findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search, fetch, get_indicative_price, request_offer, create_solution_offer, ask_integration, submit_partner_application · Private data: fetch, check_coverage, request_offer, create_solution_offer, ask_integration, submit_partner_application · Public sink: get_indicative_price, request_offer, create_solution_offer, submit_partner_application · Destructive: get_faq.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search, fetch, get_indicative_price, request_offer, create_solution_offer, ask_integration, submit_partner_application · Private data: fetch, check_coverage, request_offer, create_solution_offer, ask_integration, submit_partner_application · Public sink: get_indicative_price, request_offer, create_solution_offer, submit_partner_application · Destructive: get_faq

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
